comment: Prebuilt PPSSPP WASM emulator used by the GitHub Pages deployment when no local wasm-release build is present. Published by the upstream project (root-hunter/ppsspp-web Pages, PPSSPP 1.20.4-wasm); pinned by SHA-256 so a silent upstream change fails the build instead of shipping unknown binaries. Regenerate with: node scripts/fetch-emulator.mjs --write-lock
